title: Selected Topics in German Literature; The Brecht Provocation
description:
Cross-listed with GERM689U. Credit only granted for GERM439U or GERM689U.

This course closely examines the plays, poetry, and theoretical writings of Bertolt Brecht (1898-1956) in the Weimar Republic and in exile from Nazi Germany. Readings and viewings also situate Brecht's work in a global context, including his sources (Japanese Noh theater, Grimmelshausen, John Gay, Mei Lanfang), his interlocuters (Aristotle, Walter Benjamin, Asja Lacis), and his successors (Rhitwik Ghatak, Jean-Luc Godard, Nagisa Oshima, Wolf Biermann). Taught in German.
